description: This file 'Program.cs' is the main startup/configuration source code for an ASP.NET Core web API backend. It configures services, middleware, endpoints, authentication, authorization, OpenAPI/Swagger, CORS, and database connections, and sets up various API routes related to assets management, lineage, status logs, and other resource domains.

methods.name: LoadDotEnvIfPresent
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a .env file if it exists, ensuring secrets are available before configuration.

methods.name: RequestValidation.ValidateAndThrow
methods.description: Validates request objects according to their validation rules, throwing exceptions if validation fails.

methods.name: AssetFlows.CreateAssetAsync
methods.description: Creates a new asset record in the database within a specified flow request context.

methods.name: AssetFlows.GetAssetAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an asset by ID from the database.

methods.name: AssetFlows.UpdateAssetAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing asset record.

methods.name: AssetFlows.QueryAssetsAsync
methods.description: Performs a filtered query of assets based on request parameters.

methods.name: AssetFlows.DeleteAssetAsync
methods.description: Soft-deletes an asset by ID.

methods.name: AssetCopyFlows.CopyAssetAsync
methods.description: Copies an asset and its lineage, recording the copy operation.

methods.name: AssetCopyLineageFlows.CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a record of copy lineage for an asset copy operation.

methods.name: AssetCopyLineageFlows.QueryAsync
methods.description: Queries copy lineage records based on provided filters.

methods.name: AssetChildFlows.CreateAssetStatusLogAsync
methods.description: Creates a new status log record for an asset.

methods.name: AssetChildFlows.ListAssetStatusLogsAsync
methods.description: Lists all status logs for a specific asset.

methods.name: AssetChildFlows.GetAssetStatusLogByIdAsync
methods.description: Gets a specific asset status log by ID.

methods.name: AssetChildFlows.UpdateAssetStatusLogAsync
methods.description: Updates an asset status log record.

methods.name: AssetChildFlows.CreateAdditionalAssetIdAsync
methods.description: Creates an additional asset ID record for an asset.

methods.name: AssetChildFlows.ListAdditionalAssetIdsAsync
methods.description: Lists all additional asset IDs for a specific asset.

methods.name: AssetChildFlows.GetAdditionalAssetIdByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific additional asset ID record.

methods.name: AssetChildFlows.UpdateAdditionalAssetIdAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing additional asset ID record.

methods.name: AssetChildFlows.CreateAssetPropertyAsync
methods.description: Creates a property record for an asset.

methods.name: AssetChildFlows.ListAssetPropertiesAsync
methods.description: Lists all properties for an asset.

methods.name: AssetChildFlows.GetAssetPropertyByIdAsync
methods.description: Gets a specific asset property by ID.

methods.name: AssetChildFlows.UpdateAssetPropertyAsync
methods.description: Updates an asset property record.

methods.name: AssetChildFlows.CreateControlDeviceMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a control device mapping record for an asset.

methods.name: AssetChildFlows.ListControlDeviceMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists control device mappings for an asset.

methods.name: AssetChildFlows.GetControlDeviceMappingByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific control device mapping by ID.

methods.name: AssetChildFlows.UpdateControlDeviceMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a control device mapping record.

methods.name: AssetFlows.CreateReportingAttributeMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a reporting attribute mapping for an asset.

methods.name: DatabaseHealthCheckFlow.RunAsync
methods.description: Performs a health check for the database configuration and connection.

methods.name: BuildPublishedServerUrl
methods.description: Constructs a publicly accessible URL for the server, considering environment variables and forwarded headers.

methods.name: ConfigureOpenApiDocument
methods.description: Configures the NSwag OpenAPI document with server URLs and security schemes.
